page.content:
Hulkamania's face and, later, a Hollywood nWo heel.

How Hulk Hogan connects

  • Event: WrestleMania — Hulk Hogan main-evented the first WrestleMania at Madison Square Garden.
  • Faction: nWo — Hulk Hogan's Hollywood turn made him the face of the nWo.

What is Hulk Hogan?

Hulk Hogan was WWE's 1980s national face — WrestleMania main events, the red-and-yellow act — and later crossed into WCW's nWo, a chapter that still sits on WWE's imported lore.

Key threads lead to WrestleMania and nWo.
